title: Instructions: agents choose the moment of a TermAl restart, Greg performs it (CLAUDE.md and AGENTS.md authority text)
outcome: Instructions: agents choose the moment of a TermAl restart, Greg performs it (CLAUDE.md and AGENTS.md authority text)
acceptance: CLAUDE.md and AGENTS.md (Commit and push section) carry exactly the two agreed texts below in place of the current sentences, with no other change to authority text except w-3ba4cdac7fba's Beads retirement in the same concurred diff (sha256 2a8348a4382ebd83df55add83a44bf59a245c934d706eb707ee95e2dbe1ca9bd). Edit 1 replaces "This rule grants no restart, deploy or global-configuration authority; those actions need Greg's explicit word." with: "This rule grants no restart, deploy or global-configuration authority; those acts are Greg's and need his explicit word. The moment of a TermAl restart is the agents' decision (Greg, 2026-10-02: 'Wolę aby agenci zdecydowali na moment restaru Termal. Wtedy kiedy potrzebuja poprawek. To nie jest problem, nie chce przerywać pracy.'): when running sessions need a landed fix, the Engram and TermAl coordinators agree on a moment when running work can resume, and the TermAl coordinator sends Greg, through Engram::Advisor, 'restart now' with the build hash and reason. Greg performs the restart; no agent stops or starts the TermAl host. This covers the timing of TermAl restarts only." Edit 2 replaces "Installing is not deploying: the running host keeps its build until Greg restarts it on the restart signal (build hash and reason). Nothing is installed outside the repository." with: "Installing is not deploying: the running host keeps its build until Greg restarts TermAl at the moment the coordinators choose (as above); the landing report says whether running sessions need the new build, with its build hash and reason. Nothing is installed outside the repository."
Greg has been sent the exact wording and its consequence through Engram::Advisor before the landing, and no objection from him is recorded.
The /review-changes pair and the final-diff audit are recorded as passed, naming the input fingerprint, before the landing, on this item or on w-3ba4cdac7fba, the item of the same combined change.

completion.summary: Restart-timing authority text landed in CLAUDE.md and AGENTS.md as master 8f3dab7, one concurred change together with w-3ba4cdac7fba (authority diff sha256 2a8348a4…1ca9bd). Edit 1 and Edit 2 are word for word. Conditions (a), (b) and (c) are recorded before the landing: concurrence by both coordinators; Greg sent the wording through Engram::Advisor (b9d13887 #194), with no objection; final-diff audit FULL PASS naming gate fingerprint bb64d1f7. Gate test-0fc814d7 passed. The pair had no Medium or higher (Codex 2824c90c, Claude 206ca939). Evaluation d3d24983 passed 3/3. Installed as 2b6aa967; no restart needed.
